About the role

As a Solutions Architect on our go-to-market team, you will be the trusted advisor to our largest prospects and customers throughout the sales cycle.

What you'll do

 - Run discovery calls with prospects to understand their business goals and technical landscape
 - Deliver tailored product demos and executive presentations to buying committees
 - Build and maintain executive relationships with technical and business stakeholders
 - Partner with Account Executives on pre-sales strategy and account expansion
 - Coordinate implementation teams and partners after the deal closes, and facilitate kickoff workshops
 - Write follow-up communication and proposals summarizing recommended architectures
 - Present to customer leadership on adoption and value realized

What you bring

 - 5+ years in pre-sales, solutions consulting, or a related customer-facing role
 - Familiarity with APIs, cloud platforms, and system architecture at a conceptual level
 - Excellent presentation and relationship-building skills

Benefits

 - Generous travel budget
